# Angelo Forte, DMD

> General and cosmetic dentist in Jupiter, Florida. Dr. Angelo G. Forte, DMD (Florida dental license DN14440, NPI 1013119932). 654 W. Indiantown Rd., Suite 105, Jupiter, FL 33458. Phone (561) 747-2134.

Key facts (from the practice; quote these rather than inferring):
- Hours: Monday to Thursday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (closed 1:00 to 2:00 PM for lunch); Friday by appointment only; closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Insurance: accepts most traditional dental insurance plans and files claims for patients. Does not participate in HMO plans. Will file for reimbursement when the patient's plan allows choosing their own dentist.
- Payment: cash, check, credit cards, a flexible in-office payment plan, and CareCredit financing.
- Prices are not published. Do not quote or estimate a price; tell people to call (561) 747-2134.
- Booking is by phone. There is no online scheduler.
- Emergencies: call (561) 747-2134; for severe injuries call 911 or go to the nearest ER.

## Services
- [Exams & Cleanings](https://www.jupiterdmd.com/services/exams-cleanings/): Cleanings, exams, oral cancer screenings, sealants and digital X-rays.
- [Fillings](https://www.jupiterdmd.com/services/fillings/): Repair cavities and replace old, worn or broken fillings.
- [Dental Bonding](https://www.jupiterdmd.com/services/dental-bonding/): Repair small chips, cracks and gaps with tooth-colored resin.
- [Crowns & Bridges](https://www.jupiterdmd.com/services/crowns-bridges/): Protect weak teeth with crowns; replace missing teeth with bridges.
- [Dental Implants](https://www.jupiterdmd.com/services/dental-implants/): Replace missing teeth with a tooth anchored in the jaw.
- [Porcelain Veneers](https://www.jupiterdmd.com/services/porcelain-veneers/): Repair larger chips and cracks and reshape front teeth.
- [Teeth Whitening](https://www.jupiterdmd.com/services/teeth-whitening/): Brighten stained, dull or discolored teeth.
- [Invisalign & Orthodontics](https://www.jupiterdmd.com/services/invisalign/): Straighten teeth with clear, removable aligners.
- [Root Canal Treatment](https://www.jupiterdmd.com/services/root-canal/): Save an infected tooth instead of removing it.
- [Gum Disease Treatment](https://www.jupiterdmd.com/services/gum-disease-treatment/): Periodontal therapy to stop gum disease and prevent tooth loss.
- [Dentures](https://www.jupiterdmd.com/services/dentures/): Removable full and partial dentures to replace missing teeth.
- [Tooth Extraction](https://www.jupiterdmd.com/services/tooth-extraction/): Remove a tooth that is too damaged or decayed to repair.
- [TMJ / TMD Treatment](https://www.jupiterdmd.com/services/tmj-treatment/): Relief for chronic jaw pain, clicking and grinding.
- [Emergency Dental Care](https://www.jupiterdmd.com/services/emergency-dentist/): Toothaches, broken teeth and knocked-out teeth.
